concerns.title: Bryan Medlin — XTO, Shull Crawford 15OO 115H — 10:28 AM to 02:13 PM — job 37007
concerns.text: Elevated LEL on opening the bled-off valves, handled with a hold point. The form's own words: "On 11/16/2026, I technician Bryan Medlin was assigned to the Shull Crawford 1500 115H. I arrived at approximately 10:30, at 10:45 we conducted a pre job meeting to discuss the job description afterwards the LoTo was put in place. The bled off valves were opened, we were getting high LEL, we had a hold point at this time to talk about a plan to resolve this issue. The proper authority was notified" Follow-up: this reads as the process working. Confirm with Medlin what the readings were and that the hold point and notification are reflected on the customer ticket.

In particular, fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates, SCBA and workpack inspection sheet dates, and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images and not as text, so this review can confirm that a photograph was taken and when it was taken, but not what it shows.
